methodology.regime: log(NSA REFCPI at maxREFCPI / NSA REFCPI at announcement) / ACT365 years minus prior-six-month annualized SA trend, ending one CPI reference month before the release
methodology.aggregation: Equal-weight CPI release episodes; within each episode equal-weight snapshot/side MSE; square root after aggregation
methodology.cv: Three folds, sorted unique maturity dates allocated round-robin; all reopenings of one maturity held out together; all six variants use identical folds and bonds
methodology.commonPrice: Invert clean-price seasonal multiplier and affine indexed repo carry, using archived transformations; evaluate original settlement yield/price errors
methodology.bei: Common settlement nominal residual minus common settlement TIPS residual; conditional on fitted nominal curve and local nominal-yield interpolation
methodology.uncertainty: Paired release-episode bootstrap, 10000 resamples, fixed seed 1729; exploratory, not multiplicity-adjusted
methodology.shutdownSensitivity: Exclude release episodes from 2025-10-24 through 2026-06-10 (disrupted releases and six-month trends that depend on gap-filled October 2025)
